visualObservation: The supplied product images read as smoky dark brown oak with gray/charcoal undertones, pronounced open oak grain, broad polished stainless horizontal pulls and a continuous floor base. proposedSurroundings.floor: Light-to-medium neutral natural white-oak appearance, matte, restrained knots/grain; visibly lighter than furniture. Retain/refinish suitable existing flooring where feasible after checking construction and condition.
proposedSurroundings.walls: Light warm stone/putty greige with body against white upholstery. Premium washable matte on general walls; subtle smooth Roman Clay on selected dry focal walls. Pale Oak OC-20 and Balboa Mist OC-27 are sample candidates only, not selected specifications.
proposedSurroundings.trim: Soft white trim and light interior doors; matte ceiling. Compare against actual sofa/bed fabrics before selecting a white.
proposedSurroundings.drapes: Off-white/ecru linen-look ripple-fold sheers on a discreet ceiling-height track, floor-skimming and stacked clear of openings. Add an opaque/blackout layer for bedrooms/media and night privacy as required; sheers alone are not a privacy specification.
proposedSurroundings.rugs: Large textured ivory/stone rugs with some taupe variation; maintain wood border in bedrooms.
proposedSurroundings.accents: Existing blue-and-white artwork establishes blue family; blue textiles recur, smaller butter-yellow textiles/ceramics/flowers and living green plants complement them.
proposedSurroundings.metal: Polished stainless as the actual owned finish; coordinate polished-silver lighting/hardware by physical samples instead of assuming chrome and stainless are identical.
proposedSurroundings.budget: Place and measure owned pieces first. Prioritize wall finish, full-height curtains, proportionate rugs and layered lighting; add selective custom work where functional need warrants it.
